name: Kuala Terengganu
ai_name: Kuala Terengganu town centre, Terengganu, Malaysia, at the mouth of Sungai Terengganu

notes.businesses: Shops, eateries and pharmacies as mapped on OpenStreetMap (fetched 3 Oct 2026). The list is what volunteers have mapped, not checked on the ground, so many real businesses are missing and some listed ones may have closed.
notes.shelters: No relief centre list from an official or public source has been collected for this area, so none are shown.
notes.history: Dated floods that sources say reached this town centre, from news and official reports checked on 3 Oct 2026 (details and every source opened: the project's raw-data notes). Not a complete record.
notes.depths: Depth check: the model puts more than 5 m of water at 11 of these businesses in a 1 in 100 years flood, but news reports of real floods in the town give about 0.1 to 1 m. Read the model's depths as the model's, not as what to expect.

floods.what: A shop owner on Jalan Sultan Omar recalls water rising outside his shop, the worst he knew before 2020.
Roads around the Paya Keladi business centre, next to Pasar Payang, flooded 0.1 to 0.45 m.
Heavy rain and a high tide flooded the town centre, including about 20 shops at Pasar Payang and premises on Jalan Sultan Omar. Traders said about 0.5 to 1 m inside.
floods.source: Bernama, 3 Dec 2020; Sinar Harian, 3 Dec 2020; JPS, Laporan Banjir Tahunan 2020

floods.what: Flash floods covered Jalan Kamaruddin, Jalan Sultan Omar and Jalan Gong Kapas after more than 100 mm of rain with a high tide.
floods.source: Utusan Malaysia, 23 Jan 2024; Sinar Harian, 24 Jan 2024

floods.what: Police closed Jalan Sultan Omar, Jalan Kamaruddin and Jalan Sultan Ismail for flash floods.
floods.source: The Star, 26 Dec 2025; Kosmo, 26 Dec 2025; Utusan Malaysia, 26 Dec 2025
